Class ApplicationDirectories

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.core.platform.ApplicationDirectories
public final class ApplicationDirectories extends Object
The directories where one application stores its files: its own subdirectories of the platform's Directories, one for each kind of file, never shared with another kind.

Get them from Platform.applicationDirectories(String) and its overloads. The directories are not created: create each one before writing in it.

Before 0.1.2, it was be.imgn.gaia.platform.ApplicationDirectories, in its own module, gaia-platform.

Since:
0.1.2

  • Method Details

    • checkName

      public static void checkName(String name, String role)
      Checks a name as the overloads of Platform.applicationDirectories(String) do: the name of an application, of its vendor, or of its vendor's qualifier. A name must be valid on every platform, not only on the one the JVM runs on, so that code can check it before it runs, such as an annotation processor checking the names an annotation gives. 
      ApplicationDirectories.checkName("Quuz", "application");
      Parameters:
      name - the name to check
      role - what the name is, such as vendor, which the message of the exception starts with: The vendor must not start or end with whitespace: " bar"; a control character of the name is written in the message as a Unicode escape, as \u0009 for a tab
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is blank, . or .., starts or ends with whitespace, or contains a control character or any of / \ : < > " | ? *, which some platform forbids in a file name
